name: Coccygodynia / Coccydynia
definition: Pain localized to the coccyx, commonly aggravated by sitting or rising from sitting and sometimes related to trauma, childbirth or coccygeal mobility abnormalities.

redFlags.item: Neurological or sphincter symptoms not explained by isolated coccygeal pain

core: Neurological examination when symptoms extend beyond local pain

investigations.principle: Most uncomplicated cases are diagnosed clinically.
investigations.MRI: MRI may be used for atypical pain, tumour/infection concern or persistent unexplained symptoms.
investigations.radiographs: Dynamic sitting/standing radiographs can demonstrate abnormal coccygeal mobility in selected cases.

green: Pelvic floor or musculoskeletal rehabilitation when appropriate
amber: Injection, manipulation or coccygectomy are reserved for selected persistent cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati/Guda-region pain phenotype may be documented descriptively; serious pelvic/spinal causes must first be excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Pain localized to the coccyx, commonly aggravated by sitting or rising from sitting and sometimes related to trauma, childbirth or coccygeal mobility abnormalities.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
